conflicts.zh: Web PID 文件异常，未终止任何进程
conflicts.canonical: Invalid Web PID file; no process terminated
conflicts.proposal: The Web PID record is invalid; no process was stopped.

conflicts.zh: Web PID 无效，未终止任何进程
conflicts.canonical: Invalid Web PID; no process terminated
conflicts.proposal: The Web PID is invalid; no process was stopped.

conflicts.zh: 无法写入停止标记，尚未停止 Web
conflicts.canonical: Could not write stop marker; Web has not been stopped
conflicts.proposal: Cannot write the stop marker; Web has not been stopped.

conflicts.zh: 进程信息超过核验上限
conflicts.canonical: Process information exceeds the verification limit
conflicts.proposal: Process information exceeds the verification limit.

conflicts.zh: 检查 Web 进程失败（PID %s，errno=%s）
conflicts.canonical: Could not inspect the Web process (PID %s, errno=%s)
conflicts.proposal: Failed to inspect the Web process (PID %s, errno=%s)

conflicts.zh: 内核进程身份无法解析
conflicts.canonical: Could not parse kernel process identity
conflicts.proposal: Cannot parse the kernel process identity.
The process command line is temporarily unreadable.

conflicts.zh: Web 身份记录异常，原环境保留
conflicts.canonical: Web process identity record error; original environment preserved
conflicts.proposal: The Web identity record is invalid; the environment is retained.

conflicts.zh: Web 启动脚本仍在退出，已保留容器启动器
conflicts.canonical: Web startup script is still exiting; container launcher preserved
conflicts.proposal: The Web startup script is still exiting; the container launcher is retained.

conflicts.zh: Web 进程身份已变化，未终止其他进程，请重试
conflicts.canonical: Web process identity changed. Other processes were not terminated. Retry.
conflicts.proposal: The Web process identity changed; no other process was stopped. Retry.

conflicts.zh: 已请求停止，Web 尚未退出；稍后可重试，未强杀容器启动器
conflicts.canonical: Stop requested, but Web has not exited. Retry later; the container launcher was not forcibly killed.
conflicts.proposal: Stop was requested but Web has not exited; retry later. The container launcher was not force-killed.

conflicts.zh: 停止等待被中断，请检查 Web 状态
conflicts.canonical: Stop wait interrupted. Check Web status.
conflicts.proposal: The stop wait was interrupted; check the Web state.

conflicts.zh: [会话已就绪；中止会重启 shell，cd/export 状态随重启清除]
conflicts.canonical: [Session ready. Stopping restarts the shell and clears cd/export state.]
conflicts.proposal: [Session ready; stopping restarts the shell and clears its cd/export state]
